review.title: The people form the Commonwealth
review.plain: The people living in the territory formerly called the Province of Massachusetts Bay agree with each other to form a free, sovereign and independent body politic, or state, named The Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

provisions.what: The people, inhabiting the territory formerly called the Province of Massachusetts Bay, do hereby solemnly and mutually agree with each other, to form themselves into a free, sovereign, and independent body politic, or state by the name of " THE COMMONWEALTH OF MASSACHUSETTS "

review.title: Senate may adjourn itself
review.plain: The senate has power to adjourn itself, but such adjournments may not exceed two days at a time.
powers: The senate shall have power to adjourn themselves
limits: provided such adjournments do not exceed two days at a time

provisions.what: The senate shall have power to adjourn themselves, provided such adjournments do not exceed two days at a time
conditions: provided such adjournments do not exceed two days at a time

review.title: Senate chooses its president and rules
review.plain: The senate chooses its own president, appoints its own officers and determines its own rules of proceedings.
powers: The senate shall choose its own president, appoint its own officers, and determine its own rules of proceedings

provisions.what: The senate shall choose its own president, appoint its own officers, and determine its own rules of proceedings

review.title: Senate tries impeachments
review.plain: The senate is a court to hear and determine impeachments made by the house against officers of the commonwealth for misconduct and mal-administration. Senators are sworn first. Judgment extends only to removal and disqualification from office; the person convicted may still be indicted, tried and punished under the laws.
powers: The senate shall be a court with full authority to hear and determine all impeachments made by the house of representatives
limits: Their judgment, however shall not extend further than to removal from office and disqualification to hold or enjoy any place of honor, trust, or profit, under this commonwealth

provisions.what: The senate shall be a court with full authority to hear and determine all impeachments made by the house of representatives, against any officer or officers of the commonwealth, for misconduct and mal-administration in their offices
previous to the trial of every impeachment the members of the senate shall respectively be sworn, truly and impartially to try and determine the charge in question, according to evidence
requires: shall respectively be sworn, truly and impartially to try and determine the charge in question, according to evidence

provisions.what: Their judgment, however shall not extend further than to removal from office and disqualification to hold or enjoy any place of honor, trust, or profit, under this commonwealth
forbids: judgment extending further than to removal from office and disqualification to hold or enjoy any place of honor, trust, or profit, under this commonwealth

provisions.what: the party so convicted, shall be, nevertheless, liable to indictment, trial, judgment, and punishment, according to the laws of the land

review.title: Senate quorum
review.plain: Superseded: It provided that not less than sixteen members of the senate would constitute a quorum for doing business.

provisions.what: Not less than sixteen members of the senate shall constitute a quorum for doing business

review.title: Representation of the people
review.plain: The legislature shall include a representation of the people, elected and founded upon the principle of equality. The bracketed word "annually" is printed as superseded.

provisions.what: There shall be, in the legislature of this commonwealth, a representation of the people, elected, and founded upon the principle of equality
requires: founded upon the principle of equality

review.title: Town representatives and fines
review.plain: The house of representatives may fine towns that neglect to choose and return members. Bracketed paragraphs on how many representatives towns could elect by ratable polls, and on paying members' travel expenses, are printed as superseded.
powers: the house of representatives shall have power from time to time to impose fines upon such towns as shall neglect to choose and return members to the same

provisions.what: the house of representatives shall have power from time to time to impose fines upon such towns as shall neglect to choose and return members to the same, agreeably to this constitution
provisions.binds: Towns that neglect to choose and return members
conditions: such towns as shall neglect to choose and return members to the same

review.title: Choosing representatives by written votes
review.plain: Every member of the house of representatives shall be chosen by written votes. Bracketed residence and property qualifications for representatives are printed as superseded.

provisions.what: Every member of the house of representatives shall be chosen by written votes
requires: shall be chosen by written votes

review.title: Who could vote for representatives
review.plain: Superseded: It gave every male person aged twenty-one, resident in a town for one year and holding a freehold of three pounds annual income or any estate worth sixty pounds, a right to vote for the town's representatives.

provisions.what: Every male person, being twenty-one years of age, and resident in any particular town in this commonwealth for the space of one year next preceding, having a freehold estate within the same town, of the annual income of three pounds, or any estate of the value of sixty pounds, shall have a right to vote in the choice of a representative, or representatives for the said town
provisions.holder: Every male person, being twenty-one years of age
conditions: resident in any particular town in this commonwealth for the space of one year next preceding
having a freehold estate within the same town, of the annual income of three pounds, or any estate of the value of sixty pounds

review.title: When representatives are chosen
review.plain: Superseded: It provided that members of the house of representatives would be chosen annually in May, at least ten days before the last Wednesday of that month.

provisions.what: The members of the house of representatives shall be chosen annually in the month of May, ten days at least before the last Wednesday of that month

review.title: House impeaches; senate tries
review.plain: The house of representatives is the grand inquest of the commonwealth, and all impeachments it makes shall be heard and tried by the senate.
powers: The house of representatives shall be the grand inquest of this commonwealth

provisions.what: The house of representatives shall be the grand inquest of this commonwealth
all impeachments made by them, shall be heard and tried by the senate

review.title: Money bills start in the house
review.plain: All money bills must originate in the house of representatives, but the senate may propose or concur with amendments as on other bills.
powers: the senate may propose or concur with amendments

provisions.what: All money bills shall originate in the house of representatives
requires: All money bills shall originate in the house of representatives

provisions.what: the senate may propose or concur with amendments, as on other bills

review.title: House may adjourn itself
review.plain: The house of representatives has power to adjourn itself, but such adjournment may not exceed two days at a time.
powers: The house of representatives shall have power to adjourn themselves
limits: provided such adjournment shall not exceed two days at a time

provisions.what: The house of representatives shall have power to adjourn themselves; provided such adjournment shall not exceed two days at a time
conditions: provided such adjournment shall not exceed two days at a time

review.title: House quorum
review.plain: Superseded: It provided that not less than sixty members of the house of representatives would constitute a quorum for doing business.

provisions.what: Not less than sixty members of the house of representatives, shall constitute a quorum for doing business

review.title: House powers, contempt and member privilege
review.plain: The house judges its members' elections and qualifications, chooses its speaker and officers, and sets its rules. It may imprison non-members for disrespect, threats, assaults on members or witnesses, or rescuing persons it arrested. Members may not be arrested or held to bail on mesne process while going to, returning from or attending the general assembly.
rights: no member of the house of representatives shall be arrested, or held to bail on mesne process
powers: shall be the judge of the returns, elections, and qualifications of its own members
They shall have authority to punish by imprisonment

provisions.what: The house of representatives shall be the judge of the returns, elections, and qualifications of its own members, as pointed out in the constitution; shall choose their own speaker; appoint their own officers, and settle the rules and orders of proceeding in their own house
They shall have authority to punish by imprisonment, every person, not a member, who shall be guilty of disrespect to the house, by any disorderly, or contemptuous behavior, in its presence
conditions: who shall be guilty of disrespect to the house, by any disorderly, or contemptuous behavior, in its presence
who, in the town where the general court is sitting, and during the time of its sitting, shall threaten harm to the body or estate of any of its members, for any thing said or done in the house
who shall assault any of them therefor
who shall assault, or arrest, any witness, or other person, ordered to attend the house, in his way in going or returning
who shall rescue any person arrested by the order of the house

provisions.what: no member of the house of representatives shall be arrested, or held to bail on mesne process, during his going unto, returning from, or his attending the general assembly
provisions.holder: Members of the house of representatives
forbids: arresting, or holding to bail on mesne process, any member of the house of representatives during his going unto, returning from, or his attending the general assembly

review.title: Senate and governor may punish contempt
review.plain: The senate has the same powers in like cases, and the governor and council the same authority to punish. No such imprisonment may exceed thirty days. Each house may try cases concerning its rights and privileges by committees or as it thinks best.
powers: The senate shall have the same powers in the like cases
the governor and council shall have the same authority to punish in like cases
the senate and house of representatives may try, and determine, all cases where their rights and privileges are concerned
limits: no imprisonment on the warrant or order of the governor, council, senate, or house of representatives, for either of the above described offences, be for a term exceeding thirty days

provisions.what: The senate shall have the same powers in the like cases
the governor and council shall have the same authority to punish in like cases
no imprisonment on the warrant or order of the governor, council, senate, or house of representatives, for either of the above described offences, be for a term exceeding thirty days
provisions.binds: The governor, council, senate, or house of representatives
forbids: imprisonment for either of the above described offences for a term exceeding thirty days

provisions.what: the senate and house of representatives may try, and determine, all cases where their rights and privileges are concerned, and which, by the constitution, they have authority to try and determine, by committees of their own members, or in such other way as they may respectively think best
provisions.holder: The senate and house of representatives

review.title: The Governor
review.plain: There shall be a supreme executive magistrate styled The Governor of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, whose title shall be His Excellency.

provisions.what: There shall be a supreme executive magistrate, who shall be styled, The Governor of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts ; and whose title shall be -- His Excellency

review.title: Choosing the governor; qualifications
review.plain: The governor shall be chosen, and no person is eligible unless he has been an inhabitant of the commonwealth for the seven years before his election. Bracketed wording on annual election, property and religion requirements is printed as superseded.
limits: no person shall be eligible to this office

provisions.what: The governor shall be chosen
no person shall be eligible to this office, unless at the time of his election, he shall have been an inhabitant of this commonwealth for seven years next preceding
requires: at the time of his election, he shall have been an inhabitant of this commonwealth for seven years next preceding

review.title: How the governor is elected
review.plain: Voters for senators and representatives vote for governor at town meetings; the town clerk and selectmen count, record and send sealed lists to the secretary, who lays them before the legislature. If no one wins, the house picks two of the top four and the senate elects one. Bracketed dates and "majority" are printed as superseded.

provisions.what: Those persons who shall be qualified to vote for senators and representatives within the several towns of this commonwealth, shall, at a meeting to be called for that purpose, give in their votes for a governor, to the selectmen, who shall preside at such meetings
provisions.holder: Those persons who shall be qualified to vote for senators and representatives

provisions.what: the town clerk, in the presence and with the assistance of the selectmen, shall, in open town meeting, sort and count the votes, and form a list of the persons voted for, with the number of votes for each person against his name; and shall make a fair record of the same in the town books, and a public declaration thereof in the said meeting; and shall, in the presence of the inhabitants, seal up copies of the said list, attested by him and the selectmen, and transmit the same to the sheriff of the county thirty days at least before

the sheriff shall transmit the same to the secretary's office, seventeen days at least before; or the selectmen may cause returns of the same to be made to the office of the secretary of the commonwealth, seventeen days at least before the said day
the secretary shall lay the same before the senate and the house of representatives, to be by them examined: and in case of an election, the choice shall be by them declared and published
provisions.binds: The secretary; the senate and the house of representatives

provisions.what: if no person shall have votes, the house of representatives shall, by ballot, elect two out of four persons who had the highest number of votes, if so many shall have been voted for, but, if otherwise, out of the number voted for; and make return to the senate of the two persons so elected; on which the senate shall proceed, by ballot, to elect one, who shall be declared governor
provisions.holder: The house of representatives and the senate

review.title: Governor and council
review.plain: The governor may at his discretion assemble the councillors. The governor with the councillors, or at least five of them, shall hold a council to order and direct the affairs of the commonwealth under the constitution and the laws.
powers: The governor shall have authority from time to time, at his discretion, to assemble and call together the councillors of this commonwealth
for the ordering and directing the affairs of the commonwealth

provisions.what: The governor shall have authority from time to time, at his discretion, to assemble and call together the councillors of this commonwealth for the time being

the governor with the said councillors, or five of them at least, shall, and may, from time to time, hold and keep a council, for the ordering and directing the affairs of the commonwealth, agreeably to the constitution and the laws of the land
provisions.holder: The governor with the said councillors, or five of them at least
conditions: agreeably to the constitution and the laws of the land
